Burnthrough.description: Burn-through detected — immediate weld process intervention required

Crater Cracks.description: Crater cracking detected — immediate halt and inspection required

Excessive Convexity.description: Excessive convexity observed — adjust heat input and travel speed

Excessive Penetration.description: Excessive penetration detected — reduce heat input/current

Lack of Fusion.description: Lack of fusion detected — likely insufficient heat or poor joint prep

No Label.description: Unclassified output — monitor and collect more evidence

No Weld.description: No weld bead detected — immediate process check required

Overlap.description: Overlap defect detected — adjust travel speed and deposition

Porosity.description: Gas porosity in weld bead — shielding gas or contamination

Porosity with Excessive Penetration.description: Combined porosity and excessive penetration detected

Spatter.description: Excessive spatter — electrode or gas flow issue

Undercut.description: Undercut detected — reduce travel speed or tune voltage/current

Warping.description: Warping detected — likely thermal imbalance or fixturing issue
